sources.title: Machine learning for drug-target interaction prediction: A ...
sources.snippet: Traditional experimental identification of drug–target interactions (DTIs) is especially time-consuming and costly. This comprehensive review examines how Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) are transforming DTI prediction, offering substantial potential to reduce drug development time and costs.
